title: Fernleigh Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Adorned with a charming enclosed front porch and generous outdoor living space, ‘Fernleigh’ dishes up a rustic yet inviting entrance to what exists inside.
description_expanded: 30 SAVANNAH STREETWelcome to FernleighTucked away in the heart of Seaside, Florida, Fernleigh is a charming and character-filled cottage that blends rustic coastal charm with relaxed elegance. Framed by a welcoming enclosed front porch and generous outdoor living spaces, this beloved home offers a warm and inviting retreat just moments from the beach. Once owned by the proprietors of a local antique shop, Fernleigh is thoughtfully curated with one-of-a-kind furnishings and timeless details that give the home its distinctive personality.Inviting Outdoor Living SpacesFrom the moment you arrive, Fernleigh’s front porch sets the tone—complete with rocking chairs and a classic porch swing, perfect for slow mornings and breezy afternoons. Around back, an additional outdoor living area provides even more space to unwind, featuring a newly installed charcoal grill and easy access from both the kitchen and a first-floor bedroom. Mature landscaping surrounds the home, offering privacy and a peaceful setting for outdoor dining or evening relaxation.Warm Interiors with Character and ComfortInside, the cottage feels both welcoming and thoughtfully designed. Large windows and glass doors allow natural light to pour in, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. The main living area centers around a cozy fireplace, making it an ideal gathering spot after a day at the beach. Just beyond, the dining area comfortably seats six and flows naturally into the kitchen, which features ample cabinetry and generous counter space for preparing meals and entertaining.Comfortable Bedrooms for Restful StaysThe first-floor primary bedroom offers convenience and comfort, complete with an ensuite bathroom featuring a charming claw-foot shower tub and classic pedestal sink. Upstairs, two additional bedrooms provide peaceful retreats—one with a queen bed and direct access to the expansive upper balcony, and another with two twin beds. Both rooms enjoy access to the elongated balcony, where guests can relax and take in the serene, tree-lined surroundings.A Seaside Retreat with Timeless CharacterJust a short walk from the beach, Fernleigh effortlessly blends laid-back coastal living with vintage charm. Its rustic exterior, eclectic furnishings, and thoughtfully designed spaces create a home that feels both nostalgic and welcoming. Whether you’re enjoying the porches, relaxing indoors, or strolling to the shoreline, Fernleigh offers a truly memorable Seaside escape.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer | 3 night minimum Fall | 2 night minimum WinterFEATURES1,569 square feetSteps from the private Seaside residential beach at Savannah Pavilion190 feet or a 1-minute walk to beach accessNewly installed charcoal grill (February 2021)Freestanding ice makerPeacock Alley Linens – Fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stayParking: One parking pass for one-bedroom cottages and two parking passes for two-bedroom or larger homesGolf cart policy: A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR23-002217
